subject: Post-demo: privacy & cloud partner roster + next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bradley <sarah.bradley@pahlcorp.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@pahlcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: privacy & cloud partner roster + next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for carving out time today — great discussion and useful context on the PahlCorp use case (high-volume customer support summarization with PHI redaction requirements). A few quick notes from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement and security moving in parallel with the product eval: 

Summary notes: 
- SOC 2: You asked whether Redwood has SOC 2 Type II; short answer is yes (we have Type II for processing and availability controls). I'll attach the SOC cover summary and coordinate the full report exchange via your secure upload.
- Data residency / HIPAA: We support a VPC/private deployment option for PHI workloads and have an optional on-prem artifact if you need an air-gapped architecture.
- Cloud partners / subprocessors: We discussed shared-responsibility boundaries (tokenization, object storage, analytics). To speed your vendor review, I'm attaching our current subprocessor roster CSV and a short vendor security questionnaire we usually send to initial prospects.

Action items / next steps (suggested cadence):
1) Sarah: confirm the list of systems where PII/PHI will flow (ticket storage, analytics, backups) so we can mark data-in-scope.
2) Tom: if procurement is ready, please share any template NDA or vendor intake link; we can sign and upload artifacts.
3) Redwood: attach subprocessor roster + questionnaire (attached) and propose a 30-min security scoping call next week to walk the team through controls.

Proposed slot: Tue 03/28 11:00am PT (30m) — I can set a calendar invite if that works.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20280322.csv, vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you want to go deeper on any control.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Kimberly — quick update from our side after internal sync: 

- Systems in-scope: PahlTicket (Zendesk), Analytics (BigQuery), Long-term backups (S3 in eu-west-1), internal ML feature store (GCS). We also redact PII at ingestion but some raw fields exist for debugging.
- HIPAA: PHI will be limited to a small subset of tickets; we need confirmation that Redwood's private deployment can be configured to prevent any logs from leaving the VPC and that KMS integrations are supported.
- SOC 2: procurement prefers a secure document transfer link for the Type II report. Can you provide a one-time download link or point us to an SSO-protected page?

We'll review the attached subprocessor roster and questionnaire; if anything is missing we'll flag it. Also happy to take the 03/28 slot — should we keep it to 30 minutes and include procurement?

Thanks,
Sarah

Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & cloud partner roster + next steps

Thanks Sarah — great, high level is exactly what we needed. A few clarifications and next actions from our side: 

1) SOC 2 transfer: We'll push the Type II report to a secured, expiring link via our document exchange (https://secure.redwood.ai/safe-transfer). I asked our security ops to generate a one-time S3-backed download with SSO gating; you'll get the link by EOD.

2) VPC / KMS: Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault) and we can enable a no-logging mode for application-level request traces. I'll include Marissa (Security PM) to confirm the exact logging knobs and the default retention windows.

3) Subprocessors: attached is the freshest CSV (redwood_subprocessors_20280322.csv) — it lists cloud infra (AWS us-east-1, GCP eu-west-1), storage providers, analytics partners, and a small set of monitoring vendors. Two notes: (a) S3 backups in eu-west-1 will be marked as an optional config for PahlCorp and (b) we offer a dedicated private region for enterprise customers as part of Private deployments if you need strict EU-only residency.

4) Proposed security scoping call: Tue 03/28 11:00am PT, 30m — I'll include procurement and Marissa for control-level questions. Meeting invite coming now.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20280322.csv, PahlCorp_DataFlow_Summary.xlsx

Marissa / Aditya — looping you both to (a) confirm logging/retention options and (b) track the vendor questionnaire turnaround so procurement can have an answer within 72 hours.

Kim
